# Startup in a Box — slides

> The talk deck by Martin Brian on building agentic systems with Google ADK and
> the Claude Agent SDK used together. How two frameworks — a boardroom that plans
> and a factory that builds — ship a startup while you watch.

This page (https://startup-deck.martinbrian.com) is the slide deck.

## What the talk covers

- Why two frameworks: Google ADK for high-level reasoning with typed artifacts; Claude Agent SDK for real filesystem/shell work in a loop.
- The boardroom (ADK): CEO agent + seven specialists → typed Lean Canvas + BuildPlan.
- The factory (Claude Agent SDK): supervisor + five subagents → deploys to Vercel.
- The AG-UI protocol seam that connects planning to building with one typed POST.
